l3_edits.old: requires that the first name of the first king in the dynasty coincides with the last name of the last king in this dynasty (hence, the first letter of the abbreviated name of the first king coincides with the last letter of the abbreviated name of the last king).
l3_edits.new: requires that the first letter of the abbreviated name of the first king differs from the last letter of the abbreviated name of the last king.

l3_edits.old: Thus, a dynasty of kings "ab" and "ba" is called "abba", and the dynasty, which had only the king "abca", is called "abca".
l3_edits.new: Thus, a dynasty of kings "ab" and "bc" is called "abbc", and a dynasty with only the king "abc" is called "abc".

sample_explanation_policy: Original sample inputs retained in full. Outputs regenerated using isolated L3 reference. Old output-dependent explanations replaced; post-sample definitions and constraints retained.
